title: Sar Barehna Bhare Darbaar
body:
Sar barehna bharre darbaar kadi thi amma
Mujhpe woh kaisi qayamat ki gadi thi amma
Cheenli sar se rida meri sittamgaron ne
Teri Zainab pe musibat yeh badi thi amma
Mere baazu pe layino ne rasan baanda tha
Main woh har ek musibat se laddi thi amma
Maine dekha hai badan bhai ka tukhde tukdhe
Bhai katta raha main darr pe kaddi thi amma
Saari saydaaniya bas ek rasan mein thay bandhe
Aisi Ufkaari yeh kunbe pe paddi thi amma
Tasht mein sar mere maajaye ka mene dekha
Hont par bhai ke zaalim ki chaddi thi amma
Kabar Zehra pe Taqi thi yeh sada zainab ki
Kar rahe hai yeh bayan mirza sada zainab ki
Halq par bhai ke ek kund chori thi amma
Sar barehna bhare darbaar kadi thi amma
Mujhpe woh kaisi qayamat ki gadi thi amma
